title: Every leap second on record has only ever been added, never undone.

scenes.purpose: State the rule, then let the IERS table's own range show it rising only, from 10 to 37.

visual.description: Dark field; two stat tiles land in sequence, 1972's 10 s offset first, then 2017's 37 s, both set on the same rising line so the climb reads as one direction.

chart.title: TAI-UTC offset, 1972 to 2017
chart.note: Each later value is one second more than the one before; none ever drops.

scenes.direction: Hard cut in on the hook line; the first tile lands on "10" as the table sentence starts, the second on "37" as it ends.
scenes.narration: Leap seconds are only ever added. The IERS table lists 28 values.

scenes.purpose: Restate the rule in plain type, then hold for the Commission's end card.

visual.description: Plain type sets "Never removed" as the finding sentence lands, then holds through the pointer line while the frame fades to the end card.

scenes.direction: Cut to type on "removed"; hold through the close line; fade to the end card.
scenes.narration: Each added a second; none was ever removed. See the full video.
